record.result: I added `TaskStore.summary()` in `src/tasklib/store.py`. It returns a new dict with `total`, `completed` and `pending` integer counts, worked out from the current tasks on every call. It only reads the tasks, so it doesn't change tasks, order or ID allocation, and an empty store gives three zeros. `pending` is `total - completed`, so the counts always add up. The visible tests pass (127 passed). I didn't add tests for `summary()`, since I'm not allowed to edit test files.
